Population increased in Redditch

The estimated population of Redditch in 2024 was 87,847 usual residents, a rise of 0.4% since 2023.

This meant that Redditch's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Redditch increased by 1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Redditch was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Redditch

The average (median) age rose to 40.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Redditch has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Redditch is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Redditch's population of 87,847 usual residents was made up of:

  • 16,696 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19%)
  • 54,282 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.8%)
  • 16,869 people aged 65 years and over, (19.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Redditch has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (61.8% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Redditch, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Redditch
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Redditch, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 181 people (0.2%). In total, there were 881 births and 700 deaths in Redditch.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 82 (-0.1%). There were 3,542 people entering the area and 3,624 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Redditch's population of 256 (0.3%) as a result of 573 people entering the area and 317 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Redditch was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Redditch in mid-2023 is 87,510.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 235 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 216 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 451 people.
